text_block_list.text:
Thanks in part to Hokko Tarumae's efforts, 
the revitalization of the Yukoma Hot 
Spring Village was gradually getting on 
track.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Looking good. Little by little, foot 
traffic is starting to build up—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Still, we can't just be satisfied with 
this! We have to retain our customers and 
attract new ones—and for that!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—...Well, I don't have any ideas yet. So 
let's walk around town together first!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the souvenir shop— Wait, huh? Is it 
closed?

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
A lot of shops are closed, huh. Looked 
like that soba place from earlier was shut 
down too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
――…… Attendance is up, but there are too 
few places for people to actually enjoy 
themselves…… huh.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A lot of shops are closed... And that 
building over there looks like it could 
still be used, too.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ayaa, that's the shop that was sellin' hot 
spring manju, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What a shame... Manju are so perfect for 
snacking while walking or as souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Decades ago, this place was bustling with 
customers like that, though... This town's 
atmosphere has changed quite a bit since 
then.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
You know, there used to be a footbath 
right by the entrance to town—

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I remember, I remember. We used to go 
in there all the time too, didn't we...

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, the street over there gets all 
lit up with lanterns at night. Man, it was 
gorgeous—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
............ Everyone has so many memories 
tied to this town, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, sorry, sorry. Didn't mean to bore you 
with old stories."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Not at all! That's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Um. If it's alright, could you tell me 
more of your memories of this town?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Taking a commemorative photo here used to 
be our tradition... And then, the lanterns 
stretched all the way over there—
choice_data_list:
You were listening so attentively, weren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. For some reason, I kind of took 
it personally.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Faint memories from my childhood— Greeting 
everyone on the shopping street every 
morning, the scent of the local bakery, 
the lively festivals—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Such ordinary, precious sights are 
gradually lost with the passage of time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When I think of it that way— I just 
couldn't treat it as someone else's 
problem.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to work even harder. Tomakomai, 
and here too... they're just so full of 
charm..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to say that decline is just 
inevitable. There must be so much more we 
can still do...!
choice_data_list: Let's find what we can do.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes! Let's get everyone even more 
fired up, yeah~!

Seeing the current state of the hot 
springs resort seemed to renew Hokko 
Tarumae's drive. I should help out as much 
as I can, too――
